class.name: PlayFabMatchTicketStateChange
class.description: Completed tickets expose [member match_id] and [member arranged_lobby_connection_string]. The addon does not auto-join arranged lobbies. The associated [PlayFabMatchTicket] snapshot is refreshed before this payload is emitted, but the signal stream is not lossless. Reconcile the [member PlayFabMatchTicket.status] of [member ticket] on every [signal PlayFabMatchTicket.state_changed] regardless of [member kind], and reconcile once immediately after connecting. Handlers must be idempotent.

members.member: One of [PlayFabMatchTicket]'s event-kind constants: [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.CREATED], [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_CHANGED], [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.COMPLETED], [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.CANCELLED], or [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.FAILED]. These are not status values.
Raw native ticket status snapshot; compare against [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_CREATING] through [constant PlayFabMatchTicket.STATUS_FAILED].
Matched PlayFab match id when available.
Connection string title code may pass to [method PlayFabMultiplayer.join_arranged_lobby_async].
